show:the trouble with tessa.name: The Trouble with Tessa
show:the trouble with tessa.summary:
After Tessa Fowler's skyrocketing career implodes overnight, the disgraced documentarian escapes to a small, idyllic mountain town called Lowery. It seems like the perfect place to hide: Lowery doesn't allow cellphones, doesn't have internet, and no one knows about Tessa's past.

Tessa's determination to leave their investigative days behind them disappears, however, when they find a mysterious box of recordings in their rental home's dingy basement. At first, the recordings seem to be nothing more than security footage. However, when Tessa plays a tape that appears to catch a murder in progress, they can't help but start digging into this seemingly perfect town's disturbing past.

episodes:86017.name: Part One: Tessa
episodes:86017.summary: Disgraced documentarian Tessa Fowler arrives in Lowery, a quirky rural town with minimal technology, a list of rules, and a bizarre curfew siren that blares every night. Anxious to escape the city after a recent high-profile career scandal, Tessa is just happy to be someplace quiet and isolated. After their second night of hearing unsettling noises coming from the home's dingy basement, Tessa heads downstairs to investigate and discovers a mysterious box of old VHS and audio tapes. At first, the recordings seem to be nothing more than security footage captured by a paranoid former tenant. However, when Tessa plays an audio tape that appears to have caught a murder in progress, their investigative instincts jump back into action.

episodes:86017.name: Part Two: Lowery
episodes:86017.summary: After spending a night going through the mysterious tapes, Tessa wakes up to more bad news from their producer, Aaron. Aaron sees lucrative potential in these new tapes - especially with the pair's impending legal fees. Tessa heads to the town's library to begin their research, only to discover that someone has ensured Lowery's past stays hidden. But Tessa finds a reference to a missing woman named Amelia Stokes who lived in the house they're currently renting. When Tessa's trip to a nearby bar doesn't go as planned, one local finally warms up to them, giving them a glimpse into Lowery's dark history.

episodes:86017.name: Part Three: The Bone King
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa comes clean about why they ran to away to Lowery, agrees to meet Freddy before curfew, and faces new threats as the strange walls of Lowery begin to close in.

episodes:86017.name: Part Four: Heir
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa returns to find that someone has taken the tapes. As strange noises rise from the basement, a surprise visit from Betsy changes everything.

episodes:86017.name: Part Five: Alone
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa's risky decision to recover stolen property leads to them getting trapped in a place not meant to be found—or escaped.

episodes:86017.name: Part Six: Troubles
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa finally learns the truth they've been chasing all along—one that changes everything they thought they knew about Amelia's fate.

show:the island.name: The Island
show:the island.summary: Limited series based on Adrian McKinty's upcoming novel described as an intense thriller that tells the story of a family trip that turns into a living nightmare.

show:tales from the void.name: Tales From The Void
show:tales from the void.summary:
Tales From The Void is an episodic horror anthology series adapted from the most viral and haunting stories from the depths of the internet. Based on stories from the r/NoSleep community, each tale blends genre thrills with social commentary to explore the darker side of the human psyche.

From creepy dolls to unborn children, unexplained invasions to paranormal hauntings, unsolved mysteries to serial murders, Tales From The Void draws from a wide spectrum of horror sub-genres with each episode paying homage to a classic and cult films from the eighties and nineties.

Unnerving, uncompromising, and rooted in character, Tales From The Void finds all the ways to keep you up at night.

episodes:79956.name: Into the Unknown
episodes:79956.summary:
When a mysterious black square appears in the middle of an apartment complex, suspicions develop between neighbours about the horrors it may bring. As mistrust grows, they slowly learn that the square isn't the only thing to be afraid of.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "The Black Square" by Matthew Dymerski.

episodes:79956.name: Fixed Frequency
episodes:79956.summary:
Juan and his friends spend their evenings hacking baby monitors and scaring young parents, but what happens when there's someone sinister on the other line?

Based on the r/NoSleep story "I Used to Hack Baby Monitors, One Night I Learned My Lesson" by Manen Lyset.

episodes:79956.name: Starlight
episodes:79956.summary:
Whit Barnett has always wanted to be a star, and the new game show The Magnificent Million Dollar Question seems like it could offer him that opportunity. But the show's conceit may be far darker than he could have imagined.

Based on the r/NoSleep story: "The Million Dollar Question" by Joao Ribiero.

episodes:79956.name: Carry
episodes:79956.summary:
Katie is thrilled when she learns she's pregnant, fulfilling her lifelong dream of becoming a mother. But when she learns her unborn child isn't viable, she finds that termination is not in line with her religious community's expectations.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "Pro-Life" by Grayson Grume.

episodes:79956.name: Plastic Smile
episodes:79956.summary:
Growing up with addicts for parents, Abigail's only solace is an odd porcelain doll named Betsy. Only Betsy isn't like other dolls. She moves, speaks, cries - and Betsy wants Abigail to bring her to a dark tunnel in middle of the woods.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "Betsy the Doll" by Rebecca Klingel.

episodes:79956.name: Whistle in the Woods
episodes:79956.summary:
Sawyer would love nothing more than to have a sleepover with her new best friend, Nola, in her giant, bougie home. But Nola's house has rules that must be followed. Rules that conceal a dark secret that arrives each night at 3:03 AM.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "Something Walks Whistling Past My House Every Night at 3:03" by Travis Brown.

show:13 nights of elvira.name: 13 Nights of Elvira
show:13 nights of elvira.summary: Break out the crucifix, get some garlic, and say your prayers cause Elvira's coming for a visit. Elvira takes on some of the best of the worst modern B movies like Puppet Master, Cannibal Women in the Avacodo, Jungle of Death, and Evil Bong! Skewering them in the sexy, spooky way that only she can.

episodes:71116.name: Cannibal Women in the Avocado Jungle of Death

show:slasher flesh and blood.name: Slasher
show:slasher flesh and blood.summary:
Slasher is a Canadian-American horror anthology series in which each season sees a new rampaging serial killer leave carnage in their wake as their next victims fight to stay alive. From a quiet town to a former summer camp, dark secrets are unearthed as the past refuses to die. As the body count rises, those remaining alive must figure out how to protect themselves from a killer who wants nothing more than make them suffer for their sins.

Each season features completely new story unrelated to other seasons, keeping you guessing who the killer is and who is going to be left alive in the end.

episodes:7019.name: An Eye for an Eye
episodes:7019.summary: Returning to the small town where her parents were murdered many years ago, Sarah Bennett is horrified when she finds herself at the center of a new series of murders that bear an eerily similarity to the murder of her parents.

episodes:7019.name: Digging Your Grave with Your Teeth
episodes:7019.summary: After she receives a gruesome and cryptic package in the mail, Sarah investigates the recent murders with help from an unlikely ally, leading to the discovery of a long buried secret. Robin has a close call with the killer, and Sarah's grandmother unexpectedly arrives at the Bennett home.

episodes:7019.name: Like as Fire Eateth Up and Burneth Wood
episodes:7019.summary: Unpleasant truths haunt Robin, who faces steep financial penalties for Justin's crimes. Meanwhile, a shocking misdeed from Brenda's youth causes Sarah to believe that the police have arrested the wrong person for the recent murders.

episodes:7019.name: As Water Is Corrupted Unless It Moves
episodes:7019.summary: Sarah believes the killer is using the seven deadly sins as part of their plan and is disappointed by the police chief's lack of responsiveness. Unfortunately Sarah's attempt to investigate the murders leads to misfortune.

episodes:7019.name: Ill-Gotten Gains
episodes:7019.summary: Sarah blames herself when another disturbing murder occurs. Meanwhile, Alison has mixed reactions to Dylan's TV commentaries about the killings and makes a bold move to grab the spotlight for herself.

episodes:7019.name: The One Who Sows His Own Flesh
episodes:7019.summary: Sarah learns of some unsettling information about her past from Tom Winston, which leads her to believe she knows the next target of the Executioner. Elsewhere, Chief Vaughn takes great pains to conceal the truth about his own history.

episodes:7019.name: In the Pride of His Face
episodes:7019.summary: Convinced that Sarah is the Executioner's final target, Tom Winston escapes from prison. Sarah discovers the truth about her relationship with Dylan.

episodes:7019.name: Soon Your Own Eyes Will See
episodes:7019.summary: The Executioner plans one last grand act of retribution, while Sarah is comforted by Cam after Dylan's dishonesty.

episodes:7019.name: Six Feet Under
episodes:7019.summary: A group of friends return to a retreat near Camp Motega, where they were counselors; the same place where, five years prior, they murdered another counselor in cold blood.

episodes:7019.name: Between Good and Evil
episodes:7019.summary: After a body is found and a guest vanishes, both groups discover they're trapped at the camp with communication to the outside world cut off.

episodes:7019.name: Saint Sebastian
episodes:7019.summary: As the list of victims continues to grow, the number of possible suspects narrows and the two groups are forced to cooperate despite mutual suspicion.

episodes:7019.name: Night of Hunters
episodes:7019.summary: The histories of several characters unfold in flashback, revealing surprising connections, while an innocent hiker is pulled into the unfolding drama.

episodes:7019.name: Out of the Frying Pan
episodes:7019.summary: The gruesome past and false identity of a commune member is discovered, although it may be too late to save the fellow camper they have kidnapped.

episodes:7019.name: Drone
episodes:7019.summary: Desperate to discover the identity of the killer preying on them, the remaining survivors reluctantly conduct a mock hearing to learn the truth.

episodes:7019.name: Dawn of the Dead
episodes:7019.summary: Misinterpreted evidence points everyone in a false direction, while one camper finds evidence that makes him question the motive behind the slaughter.

episodes:7019.name: The Past Is Never Dead
episodes:7019.summary: The serial killer confesses to another camper, but the rest of the stranded survivors are still in the dark as final twists and truths are divulged.

episodes:7019.name: 6am to 9am
episodes:7019.summary: On the first anniversary of a mysterious slaying, the masked killer responsible strikes again, butchering one of the earlier crime's eyewitnesses.

episodes:7019.name: 9am to 12pm
episodes:7019.summary: Connections to Kit are revealed in flashbacks, while a couple's secret affair is exposed via social media and another slaying strikes the community.

episodes:7019.name: 12pm to 3pm
episodes:7019.summary: As school is dismissed for the summer, more shocking memories from the past year surface and a teacher who tries to be an ally to Saadia pays a price.

episodes:7019.name: 3pm to 6pm
episodes:7019.summary: The Druid kills again as Amy recalls her role in Kit's death, Roberta questions multiple witnesses, and plans get underway for the solstice party.

episodes:7019.name: 6pm to 9pm
episodes:7019.summary: Roberta and Pujit identify a suspect while Violet's lurid, exploitative murder blog goes too far, making her and Joe targets of outrage and revenge.

episodes:7019.name: 9pm to 12am
episodes:7019.summary: Attendees of the solstice party are stalked by the Druid while someone engineers a violent confrontation in the basement between Angel and Dan.

episodes:7019.name: Midnight to 3am
episodes:7019.summary: Angel and Dan desperately try to escape, Roberta and Pujit get too close to the Druid, and Saadia grows closer to Connor in the hours after the party.

episodes:7019.name: 3am to 6am
episodes:7019.summary: With the identity of the Druid revealed, the few remaining survivors inside the apartment building must make a last-ditch fight for their lives.

episodes:7019.name: Thicker Than Water
episodes:7019.summary: As the various members of the Galloway family gather to depart for their annual reunion, years-long tensions and rivalries flare up, as they arrive at the private island home of patriarch Spencer. After receiving shocking news about his end-of-life plans, the group is faced with the resumption of a long-dormant round of cruel family competitions from the past.

episodes:7019.name: The Sins of the Father
episodes:7019.summary: Shocking revelations make the Galloway family competition even more difficult, as grizzly discoveries and panic grip the family, and the killer claims the first victims. Meanwhile, suspicions start to mount against one outsider following an unexpected reveal.

episodes:7019.name: In Trust
episodes:7019.summary: Reeling from witnessing a gruesome murder, the remaining Galloway family regroup to try and escape the island. But they quickly realize the competition can't be stopped, no matter what. Seamus and Christy's marriage tensions drive them further apart as more secrets from the past are revealed.

episodes:7019.name: Upstairs Downstairs
episodes:7019.summary: Paranoia and suspicion grow among the surviving group, as another body is discovered and terrible secrets from the past come to the surface.

episodes:7019.name: Family Ties
episodes:7019.summary: The family devolves into more violence as both the competition and the infighting continue, leading to bloody results.

episodes:7019.name: Face Time
episodes:7019.summary: The family members dole out justice to one of their own, as The Gentleman finds an unexpected ally.

episodes:7019.name: Goldfinger
episodes:7019.summary: More Galloways meet a horrific end as the contest continues, and The Gentleman is finally unmasked.

episodes:7019.name: Kindred
episodes:7019.summary: With The Gentleman's identity revealed, the surviving Galloways take matters into their own hands to finish the competition and escape the island.

episodes:7019.name: The Slaughterhouse
episodes:7019.summary: The city's elite are thrown into panic when a member of the upper crust is murdered by a killer dubbed "the Widow." Detective Rijkers is put on the case. The city's most powerful man, Basil Garvey, is a target and works to control the investigation.

episodes:7019.name: The Painful Truth
episodes:7019.summary: The Widow strikes again, and Kenneth Rijkers begins connecting the killings to a 12-year-old mystery, while Basil Garvey, a business oligarch, pulls a number of strings to control the investigation.

episodes:7019.name: Backbone
episodes:7019.summary: A key piece of evidence emerges as the list of victims begin to grow, and those seemingly involved with the death of Margaret Mehar begin to panic as they're pursued by both Rijkers and the Widow.

episodes:7019.name: Left Handed Justice
episodes:7019.summary: Kenneth moves on pursuing his lead suspect - apprehending him before potential harm is brought to Regina. However, the Widow isn't the only one up to cruel mischief, with the Botticelli sisters taking sinister measures to protect their fortunes.

episodes:7019.name: Everybody's Darling
episodes:7019.summary: The Widow's latest victim is found on Valentine's Day, dragged to death behind a horse and made up to look like Cupid; a torn piece of the Widow's weeds sends Kenneth and Regina off on a hunt; Salomé entertains bidders for Verdi.

episodes:7019.name: Resurrections
episodes:7019.summary: The pressure gets to Israel, who admits to her and seven other involvements in Margaret's death; Kenneth secures the suspects, freeing only Israel to operate on a friend of Regina's - inadvertently putting her into the Widow's clutches.

episodes:7019.name: Divine Secrets
episodes:7019.summary: Kenneth sets his sights on Georges.

episodes:7019.name: Vengeance
episodes:7019.summary: Kenneth's time is running out.
